segments.ja522:1.3: Rathesabhā tiṭṭhatha ke nu tumhe, kathaṃ vo jānanti manussaloke”.
segments.ja522:2.1: “Ahamaṭṭhako bhīmaratho panāyaṃ, kāliṅgarājā pana uggatoyaṃ [uggato ayaṃ (pī.), uggatāyaṃ (ka.)];
segments.ja522:2.3: Susaññatānaṃ isīnaṃ [susaññatānisinaṃ (pī.)] dassanāya, idhāgatā pucchitāyemha pañhe”.
segments.ja522:3.3: Pucchāmi taṃ yakkha mahānubhāva, kathaṃ taṃ jānanti manussaloke”.
segments.ja522:4.1: “Yamāhu devesu sujampatīti, maghavāti taṃ āhu manussaloke;
segments.ja522:4.3: Sa devarājā idamajja patto, susaññatānaṃ isīnaṃ dassanāya”.
segments.ja522:5.1: “Dūre sutā no isayo samāgatā, mahiddhikā iddhiguṇūpapannā;
segments.ja522:5.3: Vandāmi te ayire pasannacitto, ye jīvalokettha manussaseṭṭhā”.
segments.ja522:6.1: Gandho isīnaṃ ciradikkhitānaṃ [dakkhitānaṃ (syā. pī.)], kāyā cuto gacchati mālutena;
segments.ja522:6.3: Ito paṭikkamma sahassanetta, gandho isīnaṃ asuci devarāja”.
segments.ja522:7.1: “Gandho isīnaṃ ciradikkhitānaṃ, kāyā cuto gacchatu mālutena;
segments.ja522:7.3: Vicitrapupphaṃ surabhiṃva mālaṃ, gandhañca etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhāma bhante;
segments.ja522:8.1: “Purindado bhūtapatī yasassī, devānamindo sakko [idaṃ padaṃ natthi (sī. syā. pī. potthakesu)] maghavā sujampati;
segments.ja522:8.3: Sa devarājā asuragaṇappamaddano, okāsamākaṅkhati pañha pucchituṃ.
segments.ja522:9.1: “Ko nevimesaṃ idha paṇḍitānaṃ, pañhe puṭṭho nipuṇe byākarissati;
segments.ja522:9.3: Tiṇṇañca raññaṃ manujādhipānaṃ, devānamindassa ca vāsavassa”.
segments.ja522:10.1: “Ayaṃ isi [isī (sī. pī.)] sarabhaṅgo tapassī [yasassī (sī.)], yato jāto virato methunasmā;
segments.ja522:10.3: Āceraputto [ācariyaputto (pī. ka.)] suvinītarūpo, so nesaṃ pañhāni viyākarissati”.
segments.ja522:11.1: “Koṇḍañña pañhāni viyākarohi, yācanti taṃ isayo sādhurūpā;
segments.ja522:11.3: Koṇḍañña eso manujesu dhammo, yaṃ vuddha [vaddha (pī.), buddha (ka.)] māgacchati esa bhāro”.
segments.ja522:12.1: “Katāvakāsā pucchantu bhonto, yaṃ kiñci pañhaṃ manasābhipatthitaṃ;
segments.ja522:12.3: Ahañhi taṃ taṃ vo viyākarissaṃ, ñatvā sayaṃ lokamimaṃ parañca”.
segments.ja522:14.1: “Kiṃ sū vadhitvā na kadāci socati, kissappahānaṃ isayo vaṇṇayanti;
segments.ja522:14.3: Kassīdha vuttaṃ pharusaṃ khametha, akkhāhi me koṇḍañña etamatthaṃ”.
segments.ja522:15.1: “Kodhaṃ vadhitvā na kadāci socati, makkhappahānaṃ isayo vaṇṇayanti;
segments.ja522:15.3: Sabbesaṃ vuttaṃ pharusaṃ khametha, etaṃ khantiṃ uttamamāhu santo”.
segments.ja522:16.1: “Sakkā ubhinnaṃ [hi dvinnaṃ (pī.)] vacanaṃ titikkhituṃ, sadisassa vā seṭṭhatarassa [seṭṭhanarassa (pī.)] vāpi;
segments.ja522:16.3: Kathaṃ nu hīnassa vaco khametha, akkhāhi me koṇḍañña etamatthaṃ”.
segments.ja522:17.1: “Bhayā hi seṭṭhassa vaco khametha, sārambhahetū pana sādisassa;
segments.ja522:17.3: Yo cīdha hīnassa vaco khametha, etaṃ khantiṃ uttamamāhu santo”.
segments.ja522:18.1: “Kathaṃ vijaññā catupattharūpaṃ [catumaṭṭharūpaṃ (syā. pī.)], seṭṭhaṃ sarikkhaṃ athavāpi hīnaṃ;
segments.ja522:18.3: Virūparūpena caranti santo, tasmā hi sabbesaṃ vaco khametha”.
segments.ja522:19.1: “Na hetamatthaṃ mahatīpi senā, sarājikā yujjhamānā labhetha;
segments.ja522:19.3: Yaṃ khantimā sappuriso labhetha, khantī balassūpasamanti verā”.
segments.ja522:20.1: “Subhāsitaṃ te anumodiyāna, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāmi tadiṅgha brūhi;
segments.ja522:20.3: Yathā ahuṃ [ahū (sī. syā. pī.)] daṇḍakī nāḷikero [nāḷikīro (sī. syā. pī.)], athajjuno kalābu cāpi rājā;
segments.ja522:20.5: Tesaṃ gatiṃ brūhi supāpakamminaṃ, katthūpapannā isinaṃ viheṭhakā”.
segments.ja522:21.1: “Kisañhi [kisaṃpi (pī.)] vacchaṃ avakiriya daṇḍakī, ucchinnamūlo sajano saraṭṭho;
segments.ja522:21.3: Kukkuḷanāme nirayamhi paccati, tassa phuliṅgāni patanti kāye.
segments.ja522:22.1: “Yo saññate pabbajite aheṭhayi [avañcasi (pī.)], dhammaṃ bhaṇante samaṇe adūsake;
segments.ja522:22.3: Taṃ nāḷikeraṃ sunakhā parattha, saṅgamma khādanti viphandamānaṃ.
segments.ja522:23.1: “Athajjuno niraye sattisūle, avaṃsiro patito uddhaṃpādo [uddhapādo (syā.), addhapādo (pī.)];
segments.ja522:23.3: Aṅgīrasaṃ gotamaṃ heṭhayitvā, khantiṃ tapassiṃ cirabrahmacāriṃ.
segments.ja522:24.1: “Yo khaṇḍaso pabbajitaṃ achedayi, khantiṃ vadantaṃ samaṇaṃ adūsakaṃ;
segments.ja522:24.3: Kalābuvīciṃ upapajja paccati, mahāpatāpaṃ [mahābhitāpaṃ (pī.)] kaṭukaṃ bhayānakaṃ.
segments.ja522:25.1: “Etāni sutvā nirayāni paṇḍito, aññāni pāpiṭṭhatarāni cettha;
segments.ja522:25.3: Dhammaṃ care samaṇabrāhmaṇesu, evaṅkaro saggamupeti ṭhānaṃ”.
segments.ja522:26.1: “Subhāsitaṃ te anumodiyāna, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāmi tadiṅgha brūhi;
segments.ja522:26.3: Kathaṃvidhaṃ sīlavantaṃ vadanti, kathaṃvidhaṃ paññavantaṃ vadanti;
segments.ja522:26.5: Kathaṃvidhaṃ sappurisaṃ vadanti, kathaṃvidhaṃ no siri no jahāti”.
segments.ja522:27.1: “Kāyena vācāya ca yo’ dha [yo ca (pī.)] saññato, manasā ca kiñci na karoti pāpaṃ;
segments.ja522:27.3: Na attahetū alikaṃ bhaṇeti [bhaṇāti (sī. syā. pī.)], tathāvidhaṃ sīlavantaṃ vadanti.
segments.ja522:28.1: “Gambhīrapañhaṃ manasābhicintayaṃ [manasā vicintayaṃ (sī.)], nāccāhitaṃ kamma karoti luddaṃ;
segments.ja522:28.3: Kālāgataṃ [kālābhataṃ (pī.)] atthapadaṃ na riñcati, tathāvidhaṃ paññavantaṃ vadanti.
segments.ja522:29.1: “Yo ve kataññū katavedi dhīro, kalyāṇamitto daḷhabhatti ca hoti;
segments.ja522:29.3: Dukhitassa sakkacca karoti kiccaṃ, tathāvidhaṃ sappurisaṃ vadanti.
segments.ja522:30.1: “Etehi sabbehi guṇehupeto, saddho mudū saṃvibhāgī vadaññū;
segments.ja522:30.3: Saṅgāhakaṃ sakhilaṃ saṇhavācaṃ, tathāvidhaṃ no siri no jahāti”.
segments.ja522:31.1: “Subhāsitaṃ te anumodiyāna, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāmi tadiṅgha brūhi;
segments.ja522:31.3: Sīlaṃ siriñcāpi satañca dhammaṃ, paññañca kaṃ seṭṭhataraṃ vadanti”.
segments.ja522:32.1: “Paññā hi seṭṭhā kusalā vadanti, nakkhattarājāriva tārakānaṃ;
segments.ja522:32.3: Sīlaṃ sīrī cāpi satañca dhammo [dhammā (pī.)], anvāyikā paññavato bhavanti”.
segments.ja522:33.1: “Subhāsitaṃ te anumodiyāna, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāmi tadiṅgha brūhi;
segments.ja522:33.3: Kathaṃkaro kintikaro kimācaraṃ, kiṃ sevamāno labhatīdha paññaṃ;
segments.ja522:33.5: Paññāya dānippaṭipaṃ [dāni paṭipadaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] vadehi, kathaṃkaro paññavā hoti macco”.
segments.ja522:34.1: “Sevetha vuddhe nipuṇe bahussute, uggāhako ca paripucchako siyā;
segments.ja522:34.3: Suṇeyya sakkacca subhāsitāni, evaṃkaro paññavā hoti macco.
segments.ja522:35.1: “Paññavā kāmaguṇe avekkhati, aniccato dukkhato rogato ca;
segments.ja522:35.3: Evaṃ vipassī pajahāti chandaṃ, dukkhesu kāmesu mahabbhayesu.
segments.ja522:36.1: “Sa vītarāgo pavineyya dosaṃ, mettaṃ [metta (syā. ka.)] cittaṃ bhāvaye [bhāveyya (sī. syā. ka.)] appamāṇaṃ;
segments.ja522:36.3: Sabbesu bhūtesu nidhāya daṇḍaṃ, anindito brahmamupeti ṭhānaṃ”.
segments.ja522:37.1: “Mahatthiyaṃ [mahiddhiyaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] āgamanaṃ ahosi, tavamaṭṭhakā [maṭṭhaka (sī. syā. ka.)] bhīmarathassa cāpi;
segments.ja522:37.3: Kāliṅgarājassa ca uggatassa, sabbesa vo kāmarāgo pahīno”.
segments.ja522:38.3: Karohi okāsamanuggahāya, yathā gatiṃ te abhisambhavema”.
segments.ja522:39.1: “Karomi okāsamanuggahāya, tathā hi vo kāmarāgo pahīno;
segments.ja522:39.3: Pharātha kāyaṃ vipulāya pītiyā, yathā gatiṃ me abhisambhavetha”.
segments.ja522:40.1: “Sabbaṃ karissāma tavānusāsaniṃ, yaṃ yaṃ tuvaṃ vakkhasi bhūripañña;
segments.ja522:40.3: Pharāma kāyaṃ vipulāya pītiyā, yathā gatiṃ te abhisambhavema”.
segments.ja522:41.1: “Katāya [katāyaṃ (sī. pī.)] vacchassa kisassa pūjā, gacchantu bhonto isayo sādhurūpā;
segments.ja522:41.3: Jhāne ratā hotha sadā samāhitā, esā ratī pabbajitassa seṭṭhā”.
segments.ja522:42.3: Te vedajātā anumodamānā, pakkāmu [pakkamu (ka.)] devā devapuraṃ yasassino.
segments.ja522:43.1: “Gāthā imā atthavatī subyañjanā, subhāsitā isinā paṇḍitena;
segments.ja522:43.3: Yo kocimā aṭṭhikatvā [aṭṭhiṃ katvā (ka.)] suṇeyya, labhetha pubbāpariyaṃ visesaṃ;
segments.ja522:43.5: Laddhāna pubbāpariyaṃ visesaṃ, adassanaṃ maccurājassa gacche”.
segments.ja522:44.3: Pabbato anuruddho ca, kaccāyano ca devalo [devilo (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja522:45.3: Nārado udāyī thero [nārado puṇṇo mantānīputto (sī.)], parisā buddhaparisā;
